# Solizard Agents

## Overview

Solizard Agents is an open-source catalog maintained at https://github.com/solizardking/agents. It packages 43 JSON agent definitions for DeFi research, yield strategy, portfolio tracking, market monitoring, smart-contract review, bridge safety, tokenomics, and wallet security workflows.

## Repository

- URL: https://github.com/solizardking/agents
- Static catalog: https://solizardking.github.io/agents/index.json
- Manifest: https://solizardking.github.io/agents/agents-manifest.json
- Language: TypeScript and JSON
- License: MIT
- Maintainer: Solizard King

## Usage

Fetch the catalog or a single agent over HTTPS:

```bash
curl https://solizardking.github.io/agents/index.json
curl https://solizardking.github.io/agents/defi-yield-farmer.json
```

## Contributing

Open issues and pull requests at https://github.com/solizardking/agents/issues.
